detail: Reported as R034 (student wrong on the key). Separately, the stored solution contradicts itself: it calls Assertion false, then derives 'A is true', then picks (d). Its formula I=2I0cos²(φ/2) is wrong for single-wave intensity I0 (should be 4I0cos²(φ/2) = 2I0 at π/2). Reason R ('always the sum') is also false in general, so faculty should check whether any option is valid (repair: unsound).

Reported as R035 (student wrong on the key). The solution says 'Insulin and glucagon work synergistically', which is wrong: they are antagonistic. The stem also carries stray list markup (<ol><li>) from an imported question number (repair: noise).
Beyond the reported 'plexux': the solution also has 'prominant' (prominent) and 'Maceus' (mucous).
Reported as R021 (mcq/scq). Also filed under 'Mathematics in physics' though it is a radioactive-decay (mean life) problem.
Solution labels read 'P_eqcu' and 'P_eqch' (garbled subscripts); intended P_eq and P each lens. Key 5 D is correct (verified).
Besides the reported exam tag, the stem renders 'part ofleaf' (no space across a span boundary).
Solution writes v − dx/dt − Aω cos ωt where '=' was intended (two minus signs).
